name: What kind of warranty can I expect with a new metal roof?

mainEntity.name: What kind of warranty can I expect with a new metal roof?

acceptedAnswer.text: Metal roofs typically come with two types of warranties: a manufacturer's warranty covering the materials (e.g., against defects, fading, or chipping) and a contractor's warranty covering the installation workmanship. Manufacturer warranties often range from 20 to 50 years, and sometimes even lifetime. When considering your options, it's a first-party insight that our company provides clear documentation for both material and labor warranties, ensuring peace of mind for our customers in cities like Arlington or Dallas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Metal roofs come with manufacturer warranties for materials (20-50+ years) and contractor warranties for installation. Our company provides clear documentation for both.
